rows.note: A hemispherical surface burst of W behaves like a spherical free-air burst of 1.8W. So the free-air value at range R for charge W is the surface value for charge W/1.8: Z_surface = Z_free * 1.8^(1/3) = 1.2164 * Z_free; scaled times and impulses are multiplied by (W/1.8)^(1/3). 2.0 is the ideal rigid-ground value.
